source: standard S-record data-record intervals from the verified clean 4.040 container
interpretation: The S-record stream leaves several multi-megabyte erased/reserved ranges inside the mapped flash address space. These are potential placement areas for a new eSCL handler, subject to bootloader range checks, image checksums/signatures, linker/runtime assumptions, and RAM budget.
caveat: An erased S-record range is not automatically safe executable space. No code was inserted and no flash image was generated.
